annotation: The participant quickly touched their nose with their left hand, tossed their hair back with their right hand, and tilted their head back.
The participant tilted their head to the left, held their hands out in front of them, their left hand gently tapping their right fist repeatedly
The participant tilted their head to the left, extended their right arm with the index finger pointing and making circular motions, and held their left arm behind their back.
The participant scratched their chin and mouth corner with their left hand, adjusted their head position a little, and held their right hand behind them.
The participant had both hands clasped behind their back, with their head slightly bowed, their eyes darted to the right, their brow furrowed.
